In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], during the [[Imperial Skirmishes]], [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] led the forces of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] in '''attacking''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]] at the same [[Time/Legends|time]] as [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] [[Battle of Rydonni|attacked]] [[Rydonni Prime]].
